stem.text: A submarine of total mass $3200\,\text{kg}$ is at rest underwater.

stem.alt: Diagram of a submarine below a horizontal water surface line at the top and above a grey sea bed at the bottom. The submarine is labelled submarine at rest.

stem.text: The total mass of the submarine is suddenly decreased by $200\,\text{kg}$ by pumping water out of the submarine horizontally in a negligible time. The upthrust acting on the submarine is unchanged.
The change in the total weight of the submarine causes it to accelerate vertically upwards.
What is the initial upwards acceleration of the submarine?
